name: Crispy Bacon & Egg Smash
notes:
Creamy egg yolk, crispy bacon and blistered tomatoes smooshed together. Good for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 4 eggs
• 4 rashers streaky bacon
• 100g cherry tomatoes
• 100g light cream cheese
• 50g feta
• 2 spring onions
To serve:
• 4 slices sourdough

Method:
1. Bring a pan of water to the boil and gently lower in the eggs. Boil for 10 mins, then cool in cold water. Peel, separate the yolks from the whites, roughly chop the whites and set aside.
2. Heat the oven to 200°C. Lay the bacon and cherry tomatoes on a baking tray and roast for 10–12 mins, until the bacon is crisp and the tomatoes are blistered. Cool slightly, then chop the bacon.
3. Mash the yolks with the cream cheese and feta until smooth. Fold through the chopped whites, bacon and tomatoes. Slice the spring onions, keeping a handful to garnish, and stir through. Season well and mix until thick and scoopable.
4. Scoop onto hot toast and finish with the rest of the spring onion.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 12g, fibre 2g, sugars 6g, sodium 1034mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/crispy-bacon-egg-high-protein-smash
